findings.detail: privacy-minimized invocation logging matches desired state

Do not install IP-only WAKE limits: agents behind NAT and the direct Fly bypass make them neither fair nor authoritative. Prefer a measured project/API-key application limit before an edge defense-in-depth rule.

Until Cloudflare-to-Fly origin authentication is deployed, Cloudflare controls are defense in depth rather than a universal API boundary. Keep a narrow public health/recovery path and prove rollback before closing direct origin access.
